trigger: User allows the full 25000 RMB budget in one stock, without mandatory diversification
interpretation: 25000 remains the total investment cap; only stock/industry concentration restrictions are removed
stage: Exploratory; same previously examined history, not an untouched holdout
sector_signal: 50% existing Ridge/LightGBM + 50% 1/3/6-month trend; top 5 with unchanged inertia
stock_score: 25% selected-sector rank + 37.5% original within-sector stock score + 37.5% global peer/momentum score
allocation: Top 120 feasible candidates, maximize score^4 times capital; one stock permitted but not forced
execution: Unchanged next-open, main-board, 100-share lot and corporate-action ledger
evaluation: All 45 months through 2026-09-24, monthly profit/25000, target profit >=7500, all losing months
